references.text: Noah was five hundred years old. And Noah became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
The sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan. These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the human race spread over the whole earth.
This is the family history of Noah's sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
Fulfillment of the plan: The same sons mentioned before the flood are those who carry the human race forward.
Narrative concretization: Shows the three sons in action as part of the salvation plan mentioned in 6:10.
Theological consequence: Explains that the three sons from 6:10 were the means by which God's plan to repopulate the earth was carried out.
